notes.title: 🎉 New Update - Play as the 2024 Election Candidates! 🗳️
notes.notes:
🎉 Play as the 2024 Election Candidates and decide the winner yourself! 🗳️

Hey everyone!

We're excited to announce a fun new update for Super vs. World! In this latest version, you can now play as characters inspired by the Presidential and VP candidates running in the 2024 U.S. election! 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️

What's New?

[list]
[*]New Characters: Choose from a variety of new playable characters based on this year's Presidential and Vice Presidential candidates. Each one brings their own unique flair and moves to the chaotic party action!
[*]New Arena: Battle it out in our brand-new Washington D.C. arena, inspired by iconic landmarks and the bustling atmosphere of the capital city.
[/list]

Whether you're getting in the election spirit or just looking to have a blast with friends, this update adds a fresh twist to your Super vs. World battles! 🎮

Jump into the game, try out the new characters, and let us know which one is your favorite! And as always, thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes: Fixed issue that could affect using keyboard controls in single player challenge mode.  Tweaked framing on some aspect ratios.  Misc. minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Ice and Fire and Ninjas, Oh My! Update
notes.notes:
Building on our recent Major Update, we're thrilled to announce the latest additions to Super vs. World! Introducing the new Ninja characters, bringing a stealthy and dynamic look. But that's not all – get ready for an epic twist with our newly added fire and ice weapons! 🔥❄️ Engulf your enemies in blazing flames or trap them in blocks of solid ice. Be warned, the battle heats up as these elemental powers can spread back to you, adding a whole new layer of strategy and excitement. Prepare for intense battles and unforgettable moments. Dive into the fiery and frosty action!

notes.title: Super vs. World - Major Update for Remote Play Together Fest!
notes.notes:
Super vs. World just received a Major Update to not only be a part of Steam's Remote Play Together Fest (happening now), but to also bring fans of the game enhanced graphics, updated physics, new gameplay elements, and especially MORE Arenas to challenge your friends and family! 

Grab a controller, grab some family and friends, and have some fun head-stomping your way to Victory!
Want some more chaotic action? Super vs. World is playable to UP TO 8 Players at once! Have fun!

notes.title: Major Game Update!
notes.notes:
Huge update with lots of additions and improvements including single player challenges, custom character creation, new weapons, and many improvements.

Added:
-Single player challenge mode with 120 challenge stages and 3 skill levels
-Can set AI difficulty in all modes
-Improved AI
-Can add custom characters (create and share any character you want!)
-New weapons and powerups
-Custom weapons for characters
-Replaced CTF stage
-Additional options
-New stage
-New characters
-Added beta option to play 3 players on a single full-size keyboard (it's still recommended to use game controllers when if possible)
-Bug fixes
-Too many tweaks and updates to name them all
